entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: My, what a fabulous exhibit you[n]have here. I heard you're getting[n]more visitors every day.

entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: S-Sensei! Do you have a cold?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Oh, please don't worry about me.[n]This time of the year is just a little[n]difficult...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Y-Yes. I feel as though I have to sneeze[n]almost constantly. And it's almost May...

entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: Now that I think about it, there was[n]a warning of particularly strong pollen[n]today and tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Yes... It goes away somewhat when I take[n]medication, but then I'm left feeling hazy[n]all day...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: This pollen is such a nuisa—[n]Ahh... Ahh... Ahhhh... Achoo!

entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: A-And let's cut back to the studio![n]Please take care of yourself, Sensei!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It sounds like Madarame has a tough[n]time dealing with pollen.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This might just be an important[n]piece of information... Let's[n]discuss this at the hideout later!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, do you really have time to be[n]watching TV right now? You're gonna[n]be late.
